mentions.name: Katarineko
mentions.description: This web app creates personalized language-learning study plans: users select the content they want to consume, and it builds a plan of the most important words to learn to reach a target percentage of understanding, then generates a weekly short story matched to the learner's level that incorporates the new words in the context of their chosen content.
mentions.problem: The content that interests language learners is beyond their level, while the content at their level doesn't interest them; immersion content is hard to match to learner ability.
mentions.audience: Language learners who want to consume native content that interests them
mentions.source_excerpt: You select the content you want, and I create a personalized study plan to learn the most important words to achieve a target % of understanding. Then I generate a short story each week for your particular level containing the new words in the context of your content.

evidence.value: You select the content you want, and I create a personalized study plan to learn the most important words to achieve a target % of understanding. Then I generate a short story each week for your particular level containing the new words in the context of your content.
